layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Numbers right-aligned, text left-aligned in tables.

surface_styles.dashboards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift.
surface_styles.tables: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look) - Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layout, border-r border-b on cells.
surface_styles.headers: Solid background with hard bottom border. Sticky positioning z-50.
surface_styles.widgets: Use sharp edges, cardless rectangular sections separated by 1px borders.

components_instructions.general: Use pure HTML + Tailwind for structural layouts, heavily customized Shadcn for forms/tables/dropdowns.
components_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), clear hover states (hover:bg-primary/90 hover:text-white). Focus ring mandatory.
components_instructions.tables: Dense, F-pattern scanning. Use sticky headers, right-aligned numbers, monospaced fonts for currency/rates. Zebra striping for readability.
components_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Select. Ensure 1px borders, high contrast focus rings. Do not use native input type='date', use Shadcn calendar.
components_instructions.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for precise, dense interfaces.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. All normal text min 4.5:1. Tint borders toward background hue.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST have data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

image_urls.description: Admin placeholder avatar for top right profile menu

instructions_to_main_agent: Update index.css root variables to match the color palette provided in the colors object. Use Tailwind's space-separated format (e.g., --background: 210 20% 98%;).
Update tailwind.config.js to match the border radius (0.25rem).
Install custom fonts via Google Fonts or Fontsource: Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Implement the layout using a dense 'Control Room' grid. The app is a data-heavy payroll system (MEBO), so emulate a highly refined spreadsheet interface.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or standard sans-serif for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk.
Use JetBrains Mono (font-mono) for all numerical data, rates, hours, totals, and calculations to ensure decimal points align perfectly in the Daily Time Entry and Summary tables.
Avoid floating cards with drop shadows. Use a connected 1px border grid system (border-collapse style) to separate widgets.
Add 'data-testid' to every button, form field, and interactive element for automated testing requirements.
